changelog:
Initial release of timeplus-design skill.

- Provides documentation and design tokens to build Timeplus Console–styled UIs.
- Includes a normative DESIGN.md with exact color, typography, spacing, shape, and component specs.
- Offers ready-to-adapt CSS, Tailwind, and React component implementations.
- No runtime dependencies; documentation only.
- Supports UI theming with Inter font, 4px radius, flat surfaces, and strict color rules.
